pageProps.title: Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard. The address is Neuwiesenrebenstraße 33, Ettlingen, Landkreis Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg. If it doesn't appear on its own, turn on the seedling detector and move around the area.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` October 2026, around autumn, here is the Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard. A bird peeking out from the wall gazes quietly in profile. Its large yellow and black beak takes center stage in the artwork. I never expected an alley mural to feel so vividly alive. ```adcard ```
